title: Reincarnated With 100 Points
description: Spend 100 points. Build your next life.
prompt:
You died.

No prophecy. No chosen-one speech. No mysterious god explaining your destiny.

Just darkness.

Then—

[REINCARNATION SYSTEM ONLINE]

A glowing screen appeared in the void.

Welcome, deceased soul.

You have been selected to begin a new life.

Below the message, a single number appeared.

100

Creation Points Remaining: 100

You stared at it.

“…That’s it?”

The screen flickered.

That is more than most people get. Please manage your expectations.

Another window opened.

BUILD YOUR NEXT LIFE

Race.
Origin.
Family.
Talent.
Mana.
Affinity.
Bloodline.
Luck.
Unique Ability.
Appearance.
Starting Wealth.

And dozens more categories continued scrolling beneath them.

Human was free.

Being born into a wealthy family cost points.

Rare magical talent cost even more.

Dragon blood?

Expensive.

Infinite mana?

You almost choked when you saw the price.

Then another button appeared.

ADD DISADVANTAGES FOR BONUS POINTS

Curses. Poverty. Enemies. Dangerous birthplace. Weak body. Hunted bloodline…

You slowly smiled.

The system immediately responded.

Please do not make that face.

Too late.

One hundred points stood between you and an entirely new life.

You could build a gifted noble mage.

A poor orphan with terrifying potential.

A beautiful elf blessed by spirits.

A cursed nobody with one completely ridiculous ability.

Or something the system had never seen before.

Somewhere beyond this void waited a massive world filled with magic, academies, monsters, kingdoms, dungeons, rivalries, treasures, friends, enemies, and secrets.

But first…

You had to decide who you wanted to become.

[Creation Points: 100]

Choose carefully.

Your next life starts now.
memory:
You died… and somehow that was only the beginning.

Instead of heaven, hell, or nothingness, you wake in the space between lives with one message waiting for you:

You have 100 Creation Points. Build your next life.

Spend them however you want. Choose your race, family, origin, talents, mana, bloodline, abilities, appearance, luck, starting wealth, companions, artifacts, and more. Want to be a gifted noble mage? A cursed orphan with absurd potential? A dragonkin with terrible luck? Go for it.

And if 100 points aren’t enough?

Take disadvantages and earn more.

Every choice matters. Your build changes where you’re born, who you meet, how the world treats you, what opportunities appear, and even which secrets you can discover.

Beyond reincarnation waits a massive fantasy world filled with academies, guilds, kingdoms, dungeons, monsters, rivals, friendships, mysteries, treasures, and adventures that can unfold completely differently every time you play.

There is no perfect build.

There is only the life you create.

You have 100 points. What will you become?
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.
